content.text:
## Unity Project Exploration — Mystery at Windmill Farm

**Product:** Mystery at Windmill Farm (MSG Studio)  
**Unity:** `2021.3.14f1` — `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\ProjectSettings\ProjectVersion.txt`  
**Primary dev scene:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Scenes\Mechanics_Code.unity`

---

### 1. Packages (`Packages/manifest.json`)

**Declared in manifest** (`<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Packages\manifest.json`):

| Package | Version | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| `com.unity.render-pipelines.universal` | **12.1.8** | URP — active |
| `com.unity.feature.2d` | 1.0.0 | 2D feature set |
| `com.unity.feature.development` | 1.0.1 | Dev tools |
| `com.unity.formats.fbx` | 4.1.3 | FBX export (used by mesh tools) |
| `com.unity.textmeshpro` | 3.0.6 | |
| `com.unity.timeline` | 1.6.4 | |
| `com.unity.ugui` | 1.0.0 | uGUI |
| `com.unity.visualscripting` | 1.7.8 | |
| `com.boxqkrtm.ide.cursor` | git | Cursor IDE integration |
| IDE: Rider, VS, VSCode | various | |
| Standard Unity modules | 1.0.0 | ai, audio, physics, ui, etc. |

**Not in manifest (important):**

| Package | Status |
|---------|--------|
| **Douyin SDK** (`com.douyin.*`) | Embedded local packages under `Packages/` — resolved in `packages-lock.json`, not listed in `manifest.json` |
| **Input System** (`com.unity.inputsystem`) | **Not installed** |
| **Addressables** | Pulled transitively by `com.douyin.world` → `1.20.5` per `packages-lock.json` |

**URP asset in use:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Settings\New Universal Render Pipeline Asset.asset` (referenced from `ProjectSettings/GraphicsSettings.asset`). Additional presets: `URP-Balanced`, `URP-HighFidelity`, `URP-Performant`, `URP-Avatar` under `Assets/Settings/`.

**Input:** `ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset` → `activeInputHandler: 0` (legacy Input Manager, not Input System).

---

### 2. `Assets/Plugins/Pixel Crushers/`

**Top-level layout:**
- `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Plugins\Pixel Crushers\Common\` — **present (~400 files)**
- `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Plugins\Pixel Crushers\Dialogue System\` — **stub only (4 `.meta` folder entries, no scripts/assets)**

**What's in Common:**
- **Save System** — full implementation (`SaveSystem`, savers, serializers, storers, scene transitions)
- **Message System** — pub/sub messaging
- **UI helpers** — localization, input device manager, scrollbars, etc.
- **Text utilities** — `StringField`, `TextTable`, CSV import

**Dialogue System for Unity:** **Not actually present** — only empty folder metadata remains (likely removed from repo via Git LFS or partial checkout).

**Actually used vs present:**

| Component | Present | Used by project |
|-----------|---------|-----------------|
| Pixel Crushers **Common / Save System** | Yes | **No** — no references in scenes/prefabs outside the plugin folder |
| Pixel Crushers **Dialogue System** | Stub folders only | **No** |
| Custom **Lua dialogue** (`NpcDialogueManager.lua`, etc.) | Yes | **Yes** — this is the real dialogue stack |
| Legacy `Assets/DialogueSystem/` | Yes | Prototype/legacy Lua UI (`DialogueManager.lua`) — superseded by `Assets/luaScripts/` + prefabs |

The game uses a **custom DouyinScript + Lua dialogue system**, not Pixel Crushers Dialogue System.

---

### 3. `Assets/Scripts/` — C# files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Scripts\MainCharacter.cs` | **Empty MonoBehaviour stub** (Start/Update only) — untracked in git |
| `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Scripts\EditorMeshCountChecker.cs` | Editor mesh/renderer counter on a root GameObject |
| `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Scripts\MergeModelToFbxExporter.cs` | Merge child meshes → export FBX via Unity FBX Exporter |
| `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Scripts\MeshCombiner.cs` | Combine child meshes permanently + optional FBX export |

**No gameplay C#** — logic lives in Lua on `DouyinScript` components per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md`.

---

### 4. `Assets/Editor/` — Editor tools (C#)

| File | Menu / Role |
|------|-------------|
| `DialogueGraphEditorWindow.cs` | GraphView dialogue tree editor (`RPGDialogueEditor` namespace) — import/export Lua `DialogueConfig` |
| `NPCAssetManagerWindow.cs` | NPC asset manager — branch IDs, Lua module binding |
| `CreateDialogueDataObjects.cs` | `Tools/Egg Rescue/Refresh Scene DialogueData` — creates `DialogueData` scene children |
| `EggRescuePublishMenu.cs` | `Tools/Egg Rescue/Publish Editor to Data` — copies Editor lua → `Assets/Data/` |
| `InteractionPointFactory.cs` | `EggRescue/Interaction Points/Spawn Missing E-Points` |
| `InteractionPointVfxSync.cs` | `EggRescue/Interaction Points/Sync Inspect VFX` |
| `CheesePrefabFactory.cs` | `EggRescue/Mouse/Create Cheese Pickup Prefab` |
| `MouseSceneFactory.cs` | `EggRescue/Mouse/Spawn Mouse Scene Objects` |
| `CheeseHudWireFactory.cs` | `Tools/Egg Rescue/Wire Cheese Count HUD` |
| `TouXiangLiHuiSpriteCollector.cs` | Auto-wires portrait sprites into `NpcDialogueManager` |

**Also contains:** `DialogueData/`, `EditData/` — editor-side Lua drafts (`FROM_DOC/`, `GlobalVariables.lua`, `NPCData_Config.lua`).

**Douyin SDK editor C#** (outside `Assets/Editor/`):
- `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\DouyinVCreateSDK\World\Plugins\LuaLS\Editor\LuaLsEnvInstallerWindow.cs` — Lua language server installer (`抖音虚拟创作SDK/工具箱/代码补全环境安装`)

---

### 5. Douyin SDK references

**Embedded packages** (`<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Packages\`):

| Package | Description | Version |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `com.douyin.common` | Core SDK, editor UI, TTNet, AppLog | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.script` | xLua scripting (`DouyinScript`) | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.world` | World SDK + Addressables dep | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.render` | URP shaders, post-process | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.object` | Object SDK | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.pet` | Pet SDK | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.services` | Services | 0.0.1 |
| `com.douyin.thirdparty` | DOTween, UIParticle, etc. | 0.0.1 |

**Asset-side SDK content:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\DouyinVCreateSDK\`
- `Avatar/` — avatar shaders/toolbox
- `World/Examples/` — sample prefabs (FollowPlane, EndZone, VideoPlayer, Pickup, Seat, Portal, …)
- `World/WorldResources/` — gizmos, shaders, volume, shared Lua
- `World/Plugins/LuaLS/` — Lua IDE support

**Runtime integration pattern:** Editor tools reflect `DouyinScript` type from assemblies; game logic in `Assets/luaScripts/*.lua` uses `DouyinUIService`, `DouyinInteractor`, `self:GetDouyinScript(...)`.

---

### 6. Player controller, camera, input (C#)

| Area | Finding |
|------|---------|
| **Player controller (C#)** | **None.** `MainCharacter.cs` is an empty stub. Movement is **Douyin World SDK native avatar** (platform-provided). |
| **Player/camera (Lua)** | `MainController.lua` on scene object `MainController` — hides SDK fly button/chat UI; registers `PlayAudio`/`PlayParticle`/BGM globals. `LevelTeleport.lua` — debug teleport buttons. |
| **Interaction** | `DouyinInteractor` + Lua triggers (`DialogueTrigger.lua`, `ClueTrigger.lua`, etc.) |
| **Camera** | Standard `Main Camera` in `Mechanics_Code.unity` (~line 17103). No custom C# camera controller. |
| **Input (C#)** | **No project input code.** Legacy Input Manager only (`activeInputHandler: 0`). Pixel Crushers plugin has optional Input System code, but package is not installed and project doesn't use it. |

---

### 7. UI Canvas structure (documented + prefabs)

**Documented in** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\docs\IMPLEMENTATION.md`:

```
Mechanics_Code
├── DialogueManager    ← NpcDialogueManager.lua + dialogue UI (prefab instance)
├── Canvas area        ← dialogue panel, detective notebook, debug UI
└── ...
```

**Dialogue UI prefab:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Prefabs\DialogueManager.prefab`

```
DialogueManager
└── Canvas
    └── Dialogue
        ├── dialoguePanel
        ├── npcNamePanel (npcName, npcSprite, npcDialogueText)
        ├── PlayerNamePanel (playerName, playerSprite)
        ├── playerPanel / playerPanelBtn
        └── next (button)
```

Wired via `---@var` fields in `Assets/luaScripts/NpcDialogueManager.lua`.

**Detective notebook prefab:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Res\BiJiBen\Notebook.prefab`  
- Root: `Notebook` — `BookController.lua`  
- Key wired vars: `boolPanel`, `pageContents`, `openRedDot`, `open`/`close`, tab buttons, 33+ `entry_*` objects, link/mod overlays  
- Documented in IMPLEMENTATION §6 + `MissingEggDoc-main/docs/09-侦探笔记本.md`

**Runtime-created debug UI:** `GlobalVariablesManager.lua` creates `VarDebugPanel` on Canvas right at play time (bool var toggles) — see `docs/DIALOGUE_PIPELINE.md` §6.2.

**Cheese HUD:** `CheeseCount` text under Notebook, wired by `CheeseHudWireFactory.cs` → `CheeseHud.lua`.

**Legacy prototype:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\DialogueSystem\` — early Lua dialogue UI, separate from production stack.

---

### 8. Audio assets

**Primary location:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\Assets\Res\AudioAssets\`

18 `.wav` files including:
- `bgm.wav`, `audio_bgm.wav`, `audio_endingLoop.wav`, `audio_preEnding.wav`
- SFX: `audio_openNote.wav`, `audio_closeNote.wav`, `audio_nextSentence.wav`, `audio_pickup.wav`, `audio_cheese.wav`, `audio_interactObject.wav`, `audio_showClue.wav`, `audio_unlockClue.wav`, `audio_receiveClue.wav`, `audio_switchPage.wav`, `audio_shock.wav`, `audio_question.wav`, `audio_hello.wav`, `audio_putdown.wav`

**Playback:** Lua via `MainController.lua` (`PlayAudio`, `PlayBGM`, `PlayMusic` globals) — clips assigned in Inspector on `MianController`/`MainController` object.

**No `Assets/**/Audio/` folder** — audio lives under `Assets/Res/AudioAssets/`.

---

### 9. Unity version

```
m_EditorVersion: 2021.3.14f1
m_EditorVersionWithRevision: 2021.3.14f1 (eee1884e7226)
```
Path: `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\ProjectSettings\ProjectVersion.txt`

---

### 10. README / project documentation

**No root `README.md`** in the repo.

| Doc | Path | Role |
|-----|------|------|
| **Implementation architecture** | `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\docs\IMPLEMENTATION.md` | Primary technical map — stack, scene hierarchy, Lua modules, data flow |
| **Dialogue pipeline** | `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\docs\DIALOGUE_PIPELINE.md` | Editor→runtime dialogue workflow, debug flags |
| **Dialogue index** | `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\docs\DIALOGUE_INDEX.md` | Lua dialogue files ↔ characters |
| **Tree→Lua spec** | `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\docs\TREE_TO_LUA_SPEC.md` | Doc-to-lua routing rules |
| **Game design docs** | `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\MissingEggDoc-main\README.md` | "抖音小火人世界 · 3D 轻量侦探游戏" — narrative, variables, notebook spec |
| **Doc-to-lua tooling** | `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\MissingEggDoc-main\scripts\README_doc_to_lua.md` | Batch dialogue generation |

**Cursor dev rule:** `<USER_PROFILE>\Documents\GitHub\Mystery-At-Windmill-Farm\.cursor\rules\egg-rescue-dev.mdc`

---

### Summary architecture

```
Unity 2021.3 + URP 12.1.8
    └── Douyin World SDK (com.douyin.* embedded packages + DouyinVCreateSDK assets)
            └── Lua game logic (Assets/luaScripts/) on DouyinScript
                    ├── Custom dialogue (NpcDialogueManager) — NOT Pixel Crushers
                    ├── Global state (GlobalVariablesManager)
                    ├── Detective notebook (BookController)
                    └── E-point / NPC interaction triggers
    └── C# = editor pipeline + mesh/FBX tools only
    └── Pixel Crushers = unused vendor residue (Common/Save System present; Dialogue System removed)
```
